title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning chains significantly reduce final-answer accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a modular and training-free framework for spatial reasoning verification and correction. The framework constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG), which associates atomic spatial evidence extracted from Chain-of-Thought reasoning with visual entities, spatial relations, source steps, and visual evidence. Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) evaluates the reliability of visual evidence based on object existence, localization, and geometric measurements. The framework then identifies the earliest spatial evidence unit contradicted by reliable visual evidence and guides the original MLLM to revise the subsequent reasoning and final answer. Across 15 model-dataset settings, our method achieves an average accuracy of 68.94%, outperforming the compared baselines by 8.55 percentage points on average. Our code will be open-sourced.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.04759v1 全文整理；作者只承诺未来开源，PDF 中没有可用仓库 URL，因此当前不添加 Code 链接。
analysis.ideaZh: 把 spatial CoT 拆成可追溯的 evidence graph，用外部视觉模块验证 atomic claims，并从最早的可靠矛盾处重写后续推理。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接处理 VLM/MLLM visual grounding 与 spatial reasoning，并为 visual-design agent 提供一种可迁移结构：根据 rendering evidence 定位最早错误步骤，再只修正后续计划。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告三个 backbone、五个 benchmark 的总体平均 accuracy 为 68.94%，比所比较 baselines 的平均值高 8.55 个百分点，并在 15 个设置中取得 11 个最佳（Table 2, p. 6）；291 个 human-labeled evidence units 上 extractor F1 为 91.99/91.72，verifier Macro-F1 为 81.76（Table 6, p. 7）。
analysis.caveatZh: 该框架依赖显式 CoT、Grounding DINO、SAM2 与 Depth Anything v2；作者报告最关键的 contradicted 类 F1 只有 58.82，且 100-sample test 的端到端 latency 由 0.8943s 增至 2.5095s（Tables 6–7, p. 7）。
analysis.motivationZh: 空间推理失败往往起于某个中间判断与图像不一致，之后错误沿 CoT 传播。只比较最终答案无法指出错误发生在哪里，泛化的反思 prompt 也缺少可以推翻错误步骤的可定位视觉证据。
analysis.methodZh: SEG 从显式 CoT 抽取 object existence、absolute position、2D relation 与 relative depth 等 atomic evidence，并记录 entity、relation、source step 与相应 visual evidence。SERA 调用 detector、segmenter 与 depth estimator，根据 existence、localization 和 geometric measurement 的可靠性分级；系统只在可靠 evidence 明确矛盾时选择最早冲突单元，并将 structured verification report 交回原 MLLM，从该步骤重生成后续 reasoning 与答案。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、InternVL3.5-8B 与 Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct 上评测 LLaVA-Bench-in-the-Wild、RealWorldQA、POPE、GQA 与 MMHal-Bench，并补充 ScienceQA/MathVista transfer。作者报告 RealWorldQA 的 human SEF 82.12→92.47、accuracy 45→57，GQA 的 human SEF 90.94→96.70、accuracy 62→69（Table 3, p. 6）；移除 SEG 或 SERA 使 RealWorldQA 三 backbone 平均分别下降 2.92 与 3.92 points（Table 4, p. 6）。
analysis.insightZh: Process verification 应该同时记录 claim、source step 与可审计 visual evidence，并用 reliability gate 控制外部工具何时有资格推翻模型；否则强行 correction 只会把 detector 或 depth estimator 的错误注入 reasoning chain。
